summary: [spec fidelity, P3] The When of subject.lifecycle.38 says 'a scenario is re-verified and reviewed' and the Then says 'each step is accepted'. subject_lifecycle_38_a_pending_draft_does_not_freeze_a_shipped_subject (crates/canon-cli/tests/brief_scope.rs:689-746) only records evidence (attest, which is `evidence add`) and writes no review, so no review step is accepted or checked. Fix: drop 'and reviewed', or review the scenario in the test.
